output_list.reason: In the setPrices function, the variable sellPrice and buyPrice are set to newSellPrice and newBuyPrice respectively. However, they are not initialized before being used. If the contract is deployed and the function is called without any argument, the values of sellPrice and buyPrice will be unpredictable. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to manipulate the price of the token.
